recoveryAssessment: Exact three changed files/blobs and101pins compared with current clean checkout and independently recovered clean GitHub checkout. No new recovery or runtime performed.

assessment.candidate: The audit portion of existing unchecked T148 is useful and independent of crash5 closure/Windows. It inspects an existing Saref state/effect boundary; it does not introduce a source kind or memory-suppression architecture.
assessment.dependencies: T167-T176 are marked complete; T177 and final Phase10 conclusions remain open. tasks.md explicitly lists independent T148-T152 audits but keeps full Phase10 dependent on required stories/T167-T177. The proposal preserves that distinction and does not claim full T148 acceptance.
assessment.sourceHonesty: Existing Saref producer copies memorySuppressionAudit into defeatOutcomes; its validator checks scope/severity/summary. Absence of saref in SourceKinds is explicitly insufficient alone: the future audit must inspect alternative lawful source kinds and real producer/consumer/lifetime branches.
assessment.testHonesty: The envelope test uses a synthetic unrelated payload and proves envelope isolation only. Named SarefMemorySuppressionWoundIsolationTests.cs is absent. No genuine materialization/healing-survival evidence is claimed.
assessment.acceptance: Require a file/member/branch chain through producer, identity, source definitions/instances, carrier/index, consumers/lifetime and exact wound-owned heal/retire/legacy cleanup. Missing lawful producer means an explicit gap and drafted linked follow-up, not invented authority or a fake survival test. T148 remains open.
assessment.otherCandidates: NI-COLD01 is accepted design only; RP01 consumer closure, full US5 lawful ACTIVE, US6 dependencies, F1/T197/A3 and platform holds are supported by existing plan entries. No downstream acceptance is inferred.
assessment.availability: Filesystem presence and executable bits were checked without invoking any listed tool. Four file hashes match. Seven commands remain absent from current PATH; named TraceEvent/ClrMD/SOS/tool files were not found in exactly the three stated roots. The inventory makes no global absence or collection-success claim.
assessment.unprovenCapabilities: Stored reader security fields are a dated observation, not permission proof. IPC, ptrace, target pause/cost, compatibility, decoding and symbols remain UNPROVEN; no capability or sandbox change is proposed.
assessment.futureDiagnostics: EventPipe is only a possible future evidence route. Version/providers/decoder/symbols, exact owned process identity and bounded stage correlation would need separate design/source/preparation and permission. Sampled thread time is correctly distinguished from on-CPU time; a repeated stack alone does not prove nonprogress. No collector implementation, install, attach or new diagnostic is released.
assessment.priorBlocker: The one-run permit remains consumed, release NONE and52/57 unchanged. The evidence gap remains managed cause/progress/remainder or an independently justified finite budget with separate performance hold. Future discussion is not a continuation of the exhausted diagnostic chain.
assessment.gmDisposition: No gameplay or GM-authored contract changes; no new runtime prompt/example change is needed for this proposal.
